items.why: Analysts see AWS growth accelerating to 37% and a raised ~$220B 2026 capex plan as proof the AI buildout is working; UBS calls shares a coiled spring ahead of Oct 29 earnings.
Bitcoin rebounded from near $80,300 after Trump said the U.S. will not strike Iran before the midterms, with falling yields and softer oil easing pressure on risk assets.
Tech rebound after the sell-off, helped by easing Iran tensions; Bernstein recently pushed back on AI capex fears, calling the gap between spending and revenue a timing issue.
Elon Musk clarified ownership of the Terafab chip project, Tigress reiterated a Buy and $550 target ahead of Oct 21 earnings, and Q3 deliveries beat consensus.

market_note: Futures green: S&P futures up 0.42%, Nasdaq up 0.35%, VIX easing to 14.95.
summary: Stocks are bouncing Friday as tech shares rebound from the recent sell-off, helped by Trump saying the U.S. will not strike Iran before the midterms. The tape is green but investors remain wary of yields and heavy AI capex spending.
